subject: brutalistBlock
pitch:
Category: Architecture.
Subject: brutalist housing block.
Style: raw concrete brutalism.

spec.name: Brutalist Housing Block
spec.description: A raw board-marked concrete slab housing block with deep balconies, a stair and lift tower, pilotis, and a roof terrace with plant.
spec.layout: A long slab running along x, 24 m wide, 9 m deep, 16 m tall, facing +Z. Ground floor is open pilotis: chunky tapered concrete columns on a 4 m grid with a recessed glazed lobby. Above sit 4 storeys of maisonette boxes. The front facade is a deep egg-crate grid of projecting concrete balcony boxes, 6 bays by 4 floors, each with a parapet, an inset dark window and a coloured infill panel in a few bays (ochre, rust, teal) so it reads as a stacked grid with shadow depth. A taller separate stair and lift tower stands at the left end (+X) rising above the roof, joined by short bridges at each floor. Roof carries a terrace parapet, a lift overrun box, ribbed ventilation stacks and a water tank on legs. Everything is raw concrete in three tones (light, mid, stained), with board-marked horizontal ribs as thin small parts, rain stains as dark vertical streaks below sills, and dark window glass. The back (-Z) is a simpler facade with access deck walkways and rails and stair slits.

parts.builds: Ground level: a thin concrete plinth/podium slab, 18 tapered concrete piloti columns on a 4 m grid in two rows with board-mark ribs and dark stained bases, recessed glazed lobby with door frames and glowing lit panes, a cantilever entrance canopy, a few steps, and the thick soffit slab (transfer slab) at the top at y=4 with beam ribs underneath.
parts.attaches: Top face meets slabBlock at pilotisTop (y=4). Tower stands beside it at towerBase.

parts.builds: The main housing slab core from y=4 to y=16 and its front: the main concrete box (mid grey) with the egg-crate grid of 6 bays by 4 floors of projecting balcony boxes (light concrete frames with thick sides, floors, parapets), dark glass windows with mullions, and a handful of coloured infill panels in ochre, rust and teal, board-marked rib strips, drip grooves and rain stain streaks under sills, a few lit windows.
parts.attaches: Sits on pilotisTop; front plane at frontFacadePlane; roof starts at roofDeck; tower joined via bridgeLevel1.

parts.builds: Rear facade at z -4.5 to -5.5: continuous access deck walkways on each floor with concrete parapets and steel rail posts, door recesses with small windows and numbers-like small plaques, stair slit windows, plus the two gable end walls with narrow vertical window slots, board marks and stain streaks.
parts.attaches: Attaches to the back of the main box at backFacadePlane and meets the tower via the walkway ends at bridgeLevel1.

parts.builds: Separate tall tower at the +X end, 3.5 m wide x 4 m deep x 17.5 m tall, in darker concrete with vertical slit windows stacked on the stair, a cantilever top cap with chamfered edge, board-mark ribs, diagonal stair flight silhouettes seen as small dark slanted slabs in slits, concrete bridges at each floor connecting to the slab at bridgeLevel1, base buttress, lit slit lights, and a small roof lift overrun on top.
parts.attaches: Stands on the floor at towerBase and bridges meet the main block at bridgeLevel1.

parts.builds: Roof at y=16 to 17.5: thick parapet with coping and board marks, a recessed terrace area with moss patches, lift overrun box, 3 ribbed ventilation stacks with caps, water tank on stilts with banded ring ribs and ladder, aerial masts, skylight blisters and roof access hatch, stained parapet drips.
parts.attaches: Rests on roofDeck at y=16 above the main slab.
